channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: Wasatch County GOP chair charged with felony child abuse
item.description: Wasatch County GOP Chair David Nephi Johnson, accused of waterboarding a 16-year-old relative, has been arrested on charges of felony child abuse.

item.title: Letter: Some of America’s most influential “Christians” show little commitment to Christ teachings
item.description: Letter: Those who stoke self-serving ambition and lord it over others promote Hell on Earth.

item.title: Letter: Bad Bunny’s Super Bowl performance brought a brief, joyful respite from vilification
item.description: Letter: Love triumphs over hate. It is hard to hold onto that sentiment when my Hispanic neighbors are being vilified. But, I’m trying.

item.title: Letter: Rep. Burgess Owens is willing to make excuses for Trump no matter what
item.description: Letter: Trump’s racist video of the Obamas was aimed directly at his base of white nationalists. It was not a mistake. Burgess Owens would do well to understand that.

item.title: Utah ski resorts are pulling the plug on snowmaking. This is why the season will go on.
item.description: Utah's ski resorts are about to turn off their snowmaking just as a storm is expected to arrive. How much longer can ski season last?

item.title: More than a thousand Utahns protest ICE in Salt Lake City during ‘National Shutdown’
item.description: Utahns gathered in downtown Salt Lake City Friday afternoon to support a "National Shutdown" against tactics used by the federal government in an immigration crackdown.

item.title: Prop 4 repeal organizers fire paid gatherers after Utah County clerk alleges fraudulent signatures
item.description: The Utah County Clerk has turned over several petition packets to the county attorney for an investigation into whether they were forged. A total of 27 packets containing hundreds of signatures have been flagged as potentially having falsified signatures.

item.title: The University of Utah has a new proposal for the Huntsman Center. Here’s what you need to know.
item.description: After considering building a new arena, the University of Utah has changed course on the Huntsman Center. Here's what the U. is planning now.

item.title: Lawmaker denies ‘state takeover’ of SLC roads as traffic-calming bill hits opposition on Capitol Hill
item.description: The Legislature’s second crack at controlling traffic-calming measures in Utah’s capital was met with resistance from residents.

item.title: BYU football player charged with rape in southern Utah case
item.description: A Brigham Young University football standout is being charged with rape stemming from allegations in southern Utah.
